title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with six ordered APPID XDATA groups

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

documents.title: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
documents.relevant_rule: Group 1001 names the registered application that begins an XDATA group; group 1000 carries a string value.

implementation.change: The selected simple-LTYPE XDATA path admits up to six distinct ordered APPID groups. Typed validation, source binding, unchanged-state verification and staged output projection all check six references in order and retain existing work/byte budgets.
implementation.preserved_contract: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Seven-or-more APPIDs, metadata-bearing providers, earlier versions and application-specific XDATA meaning remain outside this profile.

proof.source: Six distinct APPID names and six following string payloads are exact and ordered in physical XDATA, typed readback and source-bound bare APPID records.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations preserve exact physical XDATA order and payloads. Fresh import confirms all six typed pairs and exactly one emitted record for each APPID provider. Internal binding checks prove all six provider source handles and LTYPE identity.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the sixth APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination for all four output combinations; restoring the provider succeeds on the same adapter. A late sixth-provider name mutation refuses atomically for ASCII and binary output; restoring the original name succeeds on the same adapter with exact output and readback.

limits: This qualifies only six distinct bare APPID providers, each followed by one group-1000 string, in one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA profile. Seven-or-more APPIDs, repeated provider names, metadata-bearing providers, other payload orders/compositions, LTYPE schemas, versions and application meaning remain unqualified.
The evidence proves transport and source/output identity only. It does not establish MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or general format support.
next: Extend this same bounded profile to seven distinct ordered APPID groups, preserving the four-encoding matrix, exact physical/typed identity checks, missing-provider refusal/retry and late-mutation rollback/retry. Keep eight-or-more APPIDs, metadata, other compositions and application meaning outside scope.
